author: Harvo03
quote: A fantasy experience unlike any other. Truly magical: from the character designs, the interactions, the gorgeously built world, the hidden secrets and collectibles, the intuitive gameplay, to the story. Its packed full of whimsical charm, culminating together to create a flawless video game experience, that guarantees fun, for everyone to enjoy. I can honestly say, with full confidence, that this is the standard template for video game remakes moving forward. It’s an undisputedly perfect work of art.
